verdict.rationale: Alma documents a client portal where online questionnaires are completed (alma-docs-16). It also describes a technology-enabled system that keeps every case moving with visibility at each step (alma-docs-14, alma-probe-1), and refers to a distinct evidence-collection phase (alma-docs-11, alma-supp-2week-rfe-included). This implies a structured intake rather than email attachments, but nothing states how documents are actually gathered. Missing for 10: explicit evidence checklists, in-portal document upload, automated reminders/nudges for outstanding items, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the collection workflow.
